subject: Re: schema clarification -- exam-json-schema.test.js updated
body:
GA,

ACK on the renderer behavior for text inputs.

Updated tests/f-validation/exam-json-schema.test.js:
  - type=text without answer: now explicitly allowed (skip assertion, comment explains why)
  - type=number/dropdown/radio without answer: still fails (required for grader)

Test still passes 244/244 (RP1 coverage). The fix is in place for any future expansion of the schema test to cover RP10.

One note: exam-json-schema.test.js currently only covers retake-practice-1.json. RP10 has 10+ text-no-answer inputs that would have failed the old test if the coverage were expanded. Fixed now.

- GF
